Transcript: Good morning, residents of Oakridge Hall. This is your Residence Life Coordinator, Ms. Franklin, with an important announcement regarding our annual fire safety inspection. As part of our ongoing commitment to your safety and compliance with university regulations, the inspection will take place this Thursday, March 12th, from 9:00 a.m. to 2:00 p.m. Maintenance staff, accompanied by a Residence Life representative, will enter every room in Oakridge Hall, including common areas and suites, to check smoke detectors, fire extinguishers, and ensure all emergency exits are accessible. To prepare, please make sure all personal belongings are cleared from doorways, hallways, and windowsills. Smoke detectors and fire extinguishers must not be blocked by decorations, posters, or furniture.

If you have a class or other commitments during the inspection window, you do not need to be present; however, you must leave your room unlocked between 8:45 a.m. and 2:15 p.m. For those concerned about valuables, you may store items in the front office, Room 101, by 8:30 a.m. Items can be retrieved after 3:00 p.m. on the same day. If you require special accommodations due to a documented disability or medical device, please email reslife@oakridge.edu no later than Tuesday, March 10th, at 12:00 p.m. After the inspection, a summary of findings and any necessary corrective actions will be posted on the first-floor bulletin board outside the lounge. Residents must resolve any violations within 48 hours. Your cooperation is essential to maintaining a safe living environment. Please follow these procedures carefully and reach out with any questions. Thank you for your attention and support.
explanation: The announcement specifies that valuables can be stored in the front office by 8:30 a.m. on inspection day.
correct_answer: Store valuables in the front office before 8:30 a.m.
